prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1091; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across the lower center, and the left tail lamp housing is broken with the lens split. Scuffing and paint transfer on the rear quarter panel line up with the reported strike, and the damage pattern is consistent with the impact described. No earlier damage to this vehicle is known from the records or inspection. The bills submitted show no repeated charges. Repair labor hours run slightly above what this scope of work normally requires, so I recommend a line-by-line review before approval. Plan: replace the bumper cover, tail lamp assembly, and rear quarter panel refinish, with a recheck of sensor alignment after reinstallation.
